row.title: Workers calling OpenAlex need the polite pool; closed seed items need evidence
row.body: The Replication Ledger's first live beat (beat 1, 2026-11-25 16:21 UTC, /api/beats) got HTTP 429 from OpenAlex on every call: Workers share outbound addresses and anonymous calls are limited by address. discover.js oa() now sends the project's published contact (security.txt address) as mailto, which OpenAlex serves from its polite pool, and retries a 429 once. Second lesson: seedlife --run closed Q-SEED-what-works with no Evidence line, which turned closedloop --check red on main; it now writes the probe it passed as Evidence. Probe: node --test instances/replication-ledger/worker/ and tests/foundation/test_seedlife.py. Residual risk: whether the polite pool clears the 429 is known only after the next live beat.
